relationships.toka-todo: Designates her as Ikki's proxy duel opponent.

periods.summary: Akaza brings Itsuki a plan to exploit Ikki and Stella's secret relationship. He appears at Okutama with sensational newspapers and uses his Ethics Committee authority to summon Ikki. During the so-called investigation he presides over a rigged interrogation, withholds fair conditions, adds drugs to Ikki's food, and finally frames a duel against Toka as the only way to preserve Ikki's status and Stella's father's opinion. He also abandons Ikki on the way to the final match, hoping for a forfeit. Ikki's victory destroys the plan; Akaza panics, tries to invent another duel, and is immediately flattened by Stella.

key_events.summary: Offers Itsuki a method to remove Ikki.
Shows the newspapers and takes Ikki to the Ethics Committee.
Forces Ikki into a decisive duel with Toka.
His gambit fails when Ikki wins.
